subject: MdePkg/BaseFdtLib: Header style update to FdtOverlayApply and FdtStrerror
reasons: Changes are documentation/style-only: updating IN to IN OUT in Doxygen comments and reformatting a multi-line return type onto one line
Coccinelle does not operate on comments or Doxygen annotations; it operates on C code structure
The FdtStrerror return-type reformatting (CONST CHAR8 * split across lines -> single line) is a pure formatting change not expressible in SmPL
Only 2 functions in 2 files changed; no repeated pattern across the codebase
